## Job Description (archived verbatim)
Posted: 2026-09-15

Acme Robotics builds the software that runs our warehouse robot fleet.

## Responsibilities
- Design and run the Python services that ingest fleet telemetry.
- Own event streaming on Kafka and the Postgres data model behind it.

## Requirements
- 5+ years building backend services in Python.
- Production experience with Kafka or a similar event bus.
- Go is a plus.

Compensation: $170k-$195k. Hybrid, 3 days a week in Austin, TX. Reports to the Director of Platform Engineering.
